captureMethodNotes: Paused UI only for UIAutomator: live status updates prevent idle and may leave a stale hierarchy. Playback start was validated by native joint-submission progression.
Initial empty/unstarted observations were excluded and retained separately; they do not represent a successful sync test.
Original-image reference matching identifies each video only against itself, never aligns teacher/student motion and never changes playback times.

Footer copies append 64 pixels and preserve all source picture rows before HEVC re-encoding; audio PCM is unchanged. 24/60fps variants are derived from 30fps originals, not native 24/60fps camera recordings.
limitations: No music-anchor calibration; no automatic song matching or motion alignment.
Original frame-reference identification has adjacent-frame ambiguity and one-frame identification uncertainty; its estimated start-PTS deltas are not precise panel latency.
Only qualified barcode/reference observations support visible estimates; ambiguous observations are counted explicitly.
Only this device and supplied 17.90/19.90-second originals; no long real-footage drift or other hardware certification.
No iOS, product comparison export, M1 or remote push.
